findings.title: 350,000 families in Gaza battle for shelter as winter sets in
findings.affected_population_system: Displaced households and winter shelter: ministry figures indicate 350,000 families needing shelter, more than one million displaced people in tents, 200,000 tents needing replacement, 7,500 families facing flooding risk and 2,500 families needing immediate relocation.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: 350,000 families in Gaza urgently need shelter as winter sets in, Gaza's Public Works and Housing Ministry says
findings.summary: Anadolu's 21 November infographic attributes updated quantitative shelter-risk and relocation estimates to Gaza's Public Works and Housing Ministry. The figures are a newly recovered operational detail, not verified displacement or damage newly occurring during this watch hour; original assessment and measurement dates were not provided.

bounded_discovery_context.novelty_scope: Newly recovered specific shelter/relocation risk estimates from a dated agency infographic; not an hour-new event or official new OCHA estimate.
bounded_discovery_context.duplicate_handling: Older reports of shelter damage, tents, flooding and overall displacement already exist; do not add these ministry estimates to other displacement totals, or treat the 2,500 families as already relocated.

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary recall only. Production daily Gaza collector/publisher remains authoritative.
